Q: Oracle Java Platform Extension for Visual Studio Code : "Oracle Java SE Language Server not enabled!" error message A:

You need to install a Java Development Kit(JDK) to run it in your device for development.

Download JDK as per your OS and it would work!!

Q: TypeError: '<' not supported between instances of 'NoneType' and 'int'. Anyone knows why is that? A:

In your first version:

def sort(x):
    if x < 0:
        return False
    # but then what happens if x >= 0?
    # if the code reaches this point, the function will return None

In the second version of your sort function, a boolean value is always returned. This avoids the error of comparing None to something.

Q: Excel VBA - How to convert an Object into a String A:

Are you referring to the IFormattable interface. For example in VB.NET?

Excel VBA isn't a language that will provide you with a ToString method since it doesn't support inheritance.

In your example, you are simply converting whatever the variant is to a string, but an object in VBA wont support this directly.

If you have an external COM object, this would need to be exposed in the interface to access this method to call it from VBA.

For your own classes, you could implement your own IFormattable interface for your objects, but you would have assign to that interface before being able to call the objects ToString method - possible with a helper method. You could of course just supply a ToString method for every class which will through the class interface, but if you want to include this functionality for all objects, then an interface is probably the way to go.

Hope that helps.

Q: Cannot enable RLS policy for storage.buckets table A:

You're on the right track with RLS, but there are two separate issues here.

First, RLS for Supabase Storage is applied on `storage.objects`, not `storage.buckets`. The buckets table is managed internally, so you can't enable RLS on it.

Second (and more important), your error:

"signature verification failed"

is not related to RLS — it means Supabase does not accept your JWT.

If you're using a custom token, it must be signed with your Supabase project's JWT secret and match the expected structure. Otherwise Supabase treats the request as unauthenticated and RLS won't even run.

I would start by verifying the JWT setup, then come back to RLS.

You can confirm this by checking whether Supabase accepts your token in a request — if it fails with a signature verification error, the token is not valid from Supabase's perspective and RLS will not be evaluated.

Q: How to identify table data using merged cells? A:

Use cell indexing and span properties to track merged cells and structure data correctly. Platforms like Appverse by Viewzen Labs simplify building such solutions.

Q: Java NIO: Ideal approach to high-speed sequentially streaming large binary data to a file A:

To give an “accurate” opinion, we'd need to know what kind of data the file contains (if it is a file) and what kind of processing needs to be applied.

The first thing that comes to mind is splitting the file into several smaller files, but... is that possible?.

On the other hand, you say: “Data writes would be 2 bytes each, approximately every 1/10 to a couple of seconds”, what determines that cadence?, can it be improved?.
